# Ankit Gupta — Full Stack Developer & Software Engineer

> Ankit Gupta is a Full Stack Developer and Software Engineer from India.
> He builds modern, high-performance web applications and cinematic digital experiences at the intersection of frontend elegance, scalable backend architectures, and clean code.

## Who is Ankit Gupta?

Ankit Gupta is a Software Engineer at Prometteur Solutions Pvt Ltd with a B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering from Parul University (CGPA: 8.30). He specializes in building full-stack web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and SQL. With 500+ LeetCode problems and 650+ GeeksforGeeks problems solved, he possesses strong algorithmic problem-solving capabilities alongside engineering craft.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Full-Stack Web Development
Building scalable, responsive, and secure web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and SQL.

### 2. Frontend Engineering
Crafting intuitive, performant user interfaces with React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, and Three.js for interactive 3D and cinematic web experiences.

### 3. Backend & API Architecture
Designing RESTful APIs, microservices, authentication systems (JWT, OAuth), and database schemas with strong data validation and security best practices.

### 4. Problem Solving & Algorithms
Strong foundation in Data Structures and Algorithms with 500+ LeetCode problems and 650+ GeeksforGeeks problems solved.
